dedupe_keys.name: destination earth destine platform and digital twins of the earth

description: Destination Earth is a European Commission flagship initiative to build a highly accurate digital model of the Earth, a digital twin used to model, monitor and simulate natural phenomena, hazards and related human activities. The system has three components: the DestinE Platform, a cloud-based ecosystem of decision-making tools, applications and services implemented by ESA; a data lake bringing together data from ESA, EUMETSAT, Copernicus and other sources; and the digital twins with the Digital Twin Engine implemented by ECMWF, starting with twins for climate change adaptation and for weather-induced and geophysical extremes. The platform shows a second-generation Climate DT; access is free after registration and sign-in under the platform access policy, with an access policy upgrade route for wider use. Caveats: access tiers depend on eligibility, the platform front end is rendered by script, and outputs are Earth-system simulations, not asset data. It covers Europe and the globe and supports hazard exposure and climate adaptation scenarios for infrastructure, such as extreme weather and flood projections at local detail; it complements the Copernicus land and climate records in this catalogue.
